evaluation_protocol.readout: own-model train-only K0 uniform kNN; fit-only standardized features/targets
evaluation_protocol.failure_policy: finite prefix, NaN suffix, explicit coverage

model_provenance.label: lehami: official-core matched visual adaptation
model_provenance.normalization: fixed RGB [0,1] to [-1,1]; no fitted observation statistics
model_provenance.encoder: LeHami authors' pinned ConvEncoder; not original LeWM ViT
model_provenance.loader_adaptation: skip unused stable_pretraining import; prohibit ViT factory
model_provenance.batchnorm_temporal_policy: train encoder/projector separately per raw frame across B; eval uses frozen running statistics and may batch time
model_provenance.native_core: LeHami HamiltonianPredictor: learned separable K(p/s)+V(q,u), leapfrog; no damping
model_provenance.adaptation: q32/p32 by default; full21 history momentum correction added to official causal-last4 SG, zero-initialized output; shared architecture across A/B
model_provenance.objective: official multistep q and SG-p MSE, differentiable targets, joint q,p SIGReg weight .25; frame-unit momentum
model_provenance.batchnorm_boundary: per-raw-time encoder/projector BatchNorm; no future statistics in initializer
model_provenance.readout_features: complete current phase [q,p], including inferred initial correction

calibration.kind: K0 causal observed features; each model owns its readout; same readout for teacher/autonomous
calibration.standardization: Fit288 groups only; feature/target std floor1e-6

val.aggregation: Equal record/time weights on complete support; paired conditions share initial groups and are not independent samples

metrics_scope: Future frames exclude anchor; incomplete trajectories reduce coverage and retain NaN suffix; matched-support trivial baselines
limitations: Matched K0 readout differs from author-native evaluation protocols.
Observed-history reconstruction is diagnostic, not autonomous prediction or a strict error lower bound.
kNN maps finite off-manifold queries to training labels; inspect teacher quality and nearest-fit distances.
Each model owns a train-only readout; no shared latent-space readout weights.
No test/unseen data is used for fitting, selection or evaluation.
